With over 33 years’ experience, Mr. Laram’s expertise covers a full spectrum: from front-end engineering design to start-ups, including the operation of complex facilities. Notable projects in which he has been involved include the early development of the North Field Dome in 1987, Qatar Gas’ first LNG Trains in 1991 and the NGL-4 Project in 1997.
